From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Appreciate the clarity, Alex — below is a concrete pricing sketch and answers to your questions.

Pricing sketch (USD per 1M tokens):
- Tier A (0–5M/mo): $1,200 / 1M tokens
- Tier B (5–10M/mo): $900 / 1M tokens
- Tier C (10–25M/mo): $650 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings add-on: $350 / 1M tokens (can be blended)

Example blended math (10M total; 75% chat, 25% embeddings):
- Chat tokens = 7.5M => 5M at Tier A ($1,200) + 2.5M at Tier B ($900)
- Embeddings = 2.5M => priced at $350
- Blended $/1M = ( (5*$1,200) + (2.5*$900) + (2.5*$350) ) / 10 = $895 / 1M tokens (approx)

For 12M total (75/25):
- Chat 9M => 5M Tier A + 4M Tier B
- Embeddings 3M => $350
- Blended ~$780 / 1M tokens (approx)

On new routes/models:
- Option A (fold into commitment): add expected volume for the new route into the same commitment pool; blended rates apply and we'll compute committed offsets.
- Option B (separate route): create a dedicated route with its own metering and rate (recommended if the model is materially different in cost or you'd like separate visibility). We can do a route-level discount on committed volumes.

Term / logistics:
- We can target a July 1 start for a 12-month renewal if contracting completes by end of June.
- Deal outline attached + link to DocuSign when ready: https://www.docusign.net/sign/ABCDEF123456

Next steps:
- Let me know which option you prefer for the new route.
- If budget range $45k–$65k/month maps to ~5–8M committed (depending on blended rate), we can model a few commitment scenarios and I’ll send a formal proposal.

Attachments: volume-stepups-breakdown.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks —
Marissa
